name: Fado at the Monastery
venue: Monastery of São Bento da Vitória
description: Immerse yourself in Portugal's most iconic sound with an authentic Fado performance in the historic and atmospheric setting of a beautiful monastery.
longDescription:
On May 7, 2026, the Monastery of São Bento da Vitória will host an evening of Fado music. This event presents traditional Portuguese Fado, a genre recognized for its expressive vocalists and instrumental accompaniment, typically by Portuguese guitar and classical guitar. The performance aims to showcase the emotional depth and cultural significance of Fado within a historically resonant setting.

Attendees will experience an authentic Fado performance in the grand, historic environment of the Monastery of São Bento da Vitória. The atmosphere is designed to be contemplative, allowing the music to resonate within the ancient walls of the venue. The performance will be delivered in Portuguese, the traditional language of Fado, and is suitable for an adult audience interested in Portuguese cultural heritage and music.

Tickets for "Fado at the Monastery" are available for purchase in advance. The Monastery of São Bento da Vitória is located in central Porto, within walking distance of São Bento train station and the Aliados metro station. Specific accessibility information for the venue is not provided.
